data.title: AI is giving everyone the same advice
data.description: I asked 65 AIs from 30 companies the questions people ask them every day, 127,918 times. 73 of every 100 people were told to read the same book. See every answer, and the two prompts that get you your own.
data.author: Cody Collier
data.keywords: AI advice, LLM, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, AI recommendations, same answer, AI homogenization, model fingerprint
